Preprocessing: every feature is centred and divided by its standard deviation (all rows, ddof = 1); predictions of the learners used here (unpenalized linear models, forests) do not depend on an affine rescaling of a feature, so this only conditions the optimisers. Rule for classification data: a classification data set is used only if unpenalized (multinomial) logistic regression on the standardized features misclassifies at least one training row in every training fold, i.e. the maximum-likelihood estimate exists; otherwise it is recorded as rejected and no file is written.
